title: Sable and the Spire
author: Marguerite Almeida
blurb: Coral Okafor, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
